places: EAVS reporting jurisdictions nationwide; not equal completeness by item
findings.scope: Published mode values do not sum to 100; differing reporting populations/denominators prevent treating them as exclusive population probabilities. Rejection denominates returned mail, not all turnout. Do not sum returned/counted/rejected totals across differently complete reporting sets.
findings.sourceTerms: Federal government report, public domain under roadmap Rule 5; agency supplied aggregates only.

gaps.finding: 2024 administration observations are not 2026/2028 registration deadlines, mail eligibility or same-day registration law. Verify current statutes separately; no legal default inferred.

gaps.scope: primary, municipal, off-cycle and processing durations
gaps.finding: General-election turnout is the best sourced reference, with complete 56-place observed ranges; use only as a general-election calibration. No defensible universal multiplier or counting-duration estimate established.

interpretation: Aggregate observations calibrate totals; they do not choose an individual actor outcome. Legal rules apply only to the stated jurisdiction and vintage. Missing coverage is not legal permission. No excluded source or real-person name is included.
